The adventurer lodge and its terrace over the pond.

racial.name: Momentum Affinity
racial.detail: Increased resistance to movement-restricting effects. Movement abilities have increased effect. Attacks made while moving deal increased damage. Does not add raw speed.

racial.name: Unknown Variable
racial.detail: Language adaptation. Can absorb essences, awakening stones, and skill books. Immune to identification and tracking.

racial.name: Pocket Space
racial.detail: 48-slot storage plus a coin counter. Only Nate can access it.

racial.name: Star Chart
racial.detail: Reveals the area as he explores.

log.title: Field assessment
log.detail: Rode out with Vincent Trenslow's group. Killed a rune tortoise with Comet Strike and a knife and passed. Used Moonwell for two village kids. Night watch with Vincent; a village dog gave Nate a fish. Watched Jason kill the bark lurker; volunteered to scout trap weavers but the right answer was no one. Pie with Jason and Humphrey at the pond-town lodge; the stasis breakfast came out still warm.

log.title: Iron rank
log.detail: Claimed the Comet confluence on the hotel roof garden (Lightning + Star + Wind; bonded to Spirit, awakened Comet Strike) and reached iron rank. Purged and passed out. Used the Awakening Stone of the Undertow (Moonwell, on Star), then tested Moonwell, Comet Strike, and Windward Veil with Rufus, Farrah, and Gary.

log.title: The Sunken Shrine
log.detail: Two hours south along the coast with Rufus, Farrah, and Gary (Varrow estate contract). Killed the rock crabs on the shelf and cleared the shrine; The Final Piece complete (an essence plus coin). Wind absorbed (bonded to Recovery, awakened Windward Veil).

log.title: Under the Old City
log.detail: Tannery culvert pipe beasts, the cistern nest with Gary, the flooded-tunnel eel, and Warehouse Pests. Found Tomas Reeve's drowned map, key, note, and ledger.

log.title: The Vault
log.detail: With Rufus, Farrah, and Gary: Farrah broke the ward, killed the stone centipede, claimed the Star Essence from the magic pool, and absorbed it back at the suite (bonded to Power, awakened Star Mark).

log.title: Night in Old City
log.detail: Took the Cellar Dwellers job, killed two ratlings, ran home testing momentum, and crashed in room 32.

log.title: Greenstone
log.detail: 1 iron Island permit, tracking stone touched. Room 32 at Sailor's Watch for 2 nights. Registered at the Adventure Society with Albert; intake tomorrow morning. Window-shopped essences.

log.title: Barge and delta
log.detail: Sailed all night, meditating. Pitched the momentum hammer to Gary. Jason left at the delta; Nate stayed with the team.

log.title: Verdant Fields
log.detail: Hostel night, Floorboard Feeders filler, compass pointed upstream.

log.title: The road
log.detail: Fruit wagon, walled town cottage, Cascade rolled, flower brothers, earth elemental lesson.

profile.label: Martial art
profile.value: Turning Millstone I (iron rank, DM-made smith's style): everything moves in a circle and nothing resets. Forms: Millstone Turn (pivot on a planted foot, turn a strike aside with the arm, carry it into a counter); Grinding Wheel (hammer swings loop around the body so each strike feeds the next); Empty Hand (without Invictus, the circle continues with palm, elbow and footwork). Absorbed from a skill book while conscious, late morning day 87; Millstone Turn consolidated in meditation early evening day 87 (holds at medium speed, still needs work at full speed); Grinding Wheel and Empty Hand still to drill with Rufus. No mana cost.

profile.label: System
profile.value: Aether, a talking interface. Narrates fixed rewards, speaks sparingly, cannot see Jason's interface.

essences.name: Wind
essences.state: Absorbed (bonded to Recovery, Iron 0). Natural regen: ~1%/min mana and stamina at rest (empty to full ~100 min), ~0.5%/min while active; health slower. Rises with the lowest Wind ability.

location: In Director Arella's top-floor office at the Adventure Society, holding the Magic Society letter folder, mid-morning of day 109.

missions.name: Under the Overhangs
missions.detail: Completed mid-morning day 108 at the dry-wash canyon west of Greenstone. Main COMPLETE: canyon swept and Clive Standish kept safe until his readings finished (the ruin-stone projected a flow map with distortions bending northeast toward Greenstone). Optional COMPLETE: sand-scorpions 3/3 (1 Cleansing Potion + 15 iron unlisted). Bonus COMPLETE: no intervention from Danielle Geller or her retainers. Paid: 120 iron + 1 Water Quintessence (main), 50 iron (bonus), 30 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Something in the Cellar
missions.detail: Landed and completed midday day 107 on Millers' Row (Old City). Investigated Old Marta's bakery cellar 1/1; killed the 7-foot iron-rank Rat Gorger (Starfall Feast debut) and 5 ratlings with Jason Asano 1/1; kept every Old City resident on Millers' Row unharmed 1/1. Paid on completion: 150 iron spirit coins + 40 iron unlisted (+190 iron), 1 Earth Quintessence, 1 Lightning Quintessence, bonus 1 Awakening Stone (Common, unranked).

missions.name: Mud and Teeth
missions.detail: Landed noon day 104; completed dusk day 106. Main: eliminate the aggressive mangrove snatcher 1/1 (14-ft Alpha Mangrove Snatcher at Mudbank Crossing, Feast of the Falling Star kill). Bonus: clear all 4 outer-delta village-board postings 4/4 (Village 1 Marsh Snatchers, Timber Camp Mire Snapper, Reed-Weir Ferry Whip-Fin Eels, Mudbank Crossing Alpha Mangrove Snatcher). Optional: bring Clive Standish back to Greenstone in one piece 1/1. Paid on completion: 100 iron + 35 iron unlisted + 1 Lightning Quintessence (main); 1 Water Quintessence (bonus); 50 iron (optional).

missions.name: Outer delta mangrove snatcher
missions.detail: Assigned Adventure Society contract (Director Arella). All 4 outer-delta villages cleared on day 106 (Settlement 1 Marsh Snatchers, Timber Camp Mire Snapper, Reed-Weir Ferry Whip-Fin Eels, Mudbank Crossing 14-ft Alpha Mangrove Snatcher). Turned in all 4 signed village slips at the late desk dusk/early evening day 106: 100 iron main fee + 40 iron village clearings = 140 iron split 4 ways (+35 iron to Nate). CLOSED.

missions.name: Rearranged Furniture
missions.detail: Have Magister Halen Vance examine your soul at the Magic Society East Annex 1/1. Optional: uncover a concrete lead on what is causing the changes 1/1 (Vance found an open accord—a clean mark of permission along the integration seam—touched by something non-mortal and non-divine outside the mortal rank ladder). Paid on completion: 100 iron spirit coins, 1 Wind Quintessence, 1 Awakening Stone of the Rain (unranked, common), plus 50 iron spirit coins unlisted.

missions.name: The Drowned Lamps
missions.detail: Landed afternoon day 94 at Odile's Curiosities after Odile lent Nate Henri's Shimmering Scale. Find the source of the blue-green lights past the outer reef south of Greenstone (Henri's chart) and end the threat. Objectives: find the source of the lights 0/1; return the Shimmering Scale to Odile 0/1. Condition: Nate and his companions must return alive. Rewards: 400 iron spirit coins, 1 awakening stone. Leads (Society records, morning day 95): harbour log ~20 years ago of Henri's sighting, marked 'no action'; an iron two-star Society contract 41 years ago searched 3 days and found nothing; a pearl diver vanished at dusk on the outer reef edge 8 years ago when the water 'lit up green'. Jason has joined for the research. Report filed at the Society records room (Coastal, pending review). Odile lent Marta's Luck and the shed key, morning day 95: return the boat and all five alive. Plan: dusk scouting trip, stay above water. Progress dusk day 95: find the source of the lights 1/1. Nate spotted it with Starward Gaze from the reef edge: the 40 ft row of pulsing blue-green lights (about 25 ft down, 200 ft out past the drop-off) is a lure on pale stalks rising from the real creature below, a broad, flattened mass about 60 ft long and 20 ft wide lying still on the sand about 45 ft down. Colin scouted and came back without touching it. End the threat 1/1: end of dusk day 95, the creature lunged at Farrah; Nate's Squall threw her clear, then Gatling Hammer with Comet Strike and a final Comet Strike throw into its exposed belly killed it (Nate's killing blow, with Farrah's lava burns). All five alive. The creature was a Drowned Lantern; Nate looted it from the port rail (body dissolved into rainbow smoke): Monster Core (Bronze), Drowned Lantern Lure, 8 bronze and 60 iron spirit coins. Marta's Luck took damage: splintered bow planks, gouged port gunwale, hull struck; Gary says she's taking a little water but will get them home. Return the Shimmering Scale to Odile 1/1: handed back on the fish steps at nightfall day 95, all five alive. Paid on completion: 400 iron spirit coins, 1 Awakening Stone of the Deep, plus 100 iron unlisted. Loot split on the fish steps, night day 95: Nate kept the core; the lure went to Rufus (to send to his family's academy); Gary, Farrah and Jason got 2 bronze and 20 iron each; Rufus took the last 2 bronze.

missions.name: Henri's Nets
missions.detail: Landed early afternoon day 94 at Odile's Curiosities shop (side lane off the Greenstone market streets). Odile has crates of things her late husband Henri pulled from his fishing nets. Sort through them honestly and tell her what's junk and what isn't. Objective: Sort Henri's crates 1/1. Rewards: 50 iron spirit coins, plus a chance at an item. COMPLETE afternoon day 94: all 7 crates sorted. 50 iron + 57 iron unlisted auto-deposited (+107); item roll missed, no item.

missions.name: Putting a Lid on It
missions.detail: Landed and accepted morning day 93 in Director Arella's office (quiet Adventure Society contract, Rufus's team escorting). Objectives: guide the Society's capping crew to the upwelling chamber under the Old City 1/1 (crew reached the Cistern 3 grate, mid-morning day 94); see the upwelling properly capped 1/1 (Hesk's stone lid, chained and bolted, mid-morning day 94). Bonus: bring the whole crew back up with no serious injuries 1/1 (all back in the Wet Barrel unhurt, day 94). Optional: find out where the freshly bricked-up archway leads 0/1. Rewards: 150 iron spirit coins, 1 Earth Quintessence, 1 Lightning Quintessence. Bonus: 1 common awakening stone. Optional: 50 iron spirit coins. MAIN OBJECTIVES COMPLETE mid-morning day 94: 150 iron + 50 iron unlisted, 1 Earth Quintessence, 1 Lightning Quintessence auto-deposited. BONUS COMPLETE day 94: 1 common awakening stone + 15 iron unlisted auto-deposited. Optional (bricked archway) skipped for now by Nate's choice, still OPEN. Reeve map returned to Arella day 94, along with the slab and the manifestation (under Society seal). The optional archway stays open; Arella wants to be told first.

missions.name: Drain work (Director Arella)
missions.detail: Private Adventure Society contract (not posted), collected and signed for early afternoon day 93; read in the Society reading room. Task: guide a Society capping crew (4 earth specialists under a crew chief, who has authority over the capping) to the upwelling beneath the Old City drains by the known route, and stay until it is sealed. Rufus's team escorts and has authority from street to chamber. Assembly: the Wet Barrel, Old City docks, dawn day 94; bring the Reeve map. Fee: 40 iron on completion, paid at the jobs hall desk. Conditions: the bricked archway may be examined from outside only, and nobody goes through unless the crew chief judges it safe; any Waterworks finds stay where they lie or go to Arella's office, never sold or shown elsewhere; the contract is confidential. COMPLETE day 94: Dunmore signed the slip; 40 iron paid at the jobs hall desk (clerk kept the packet). Reeve map returned to Arella.

missions.name: Grinding the Stone
missions.detail: Landed late morning day 87. Objectives: drill all three Turning Millstone forms (Millstone Turn, Grinding Wheel, Empty Hand) with Rufus; return to Hollis's forge and show her the style. Bonus: land a full Grinding Wheel chain with Invictus in a spar with Rufus. Rewards: 80 iron, 1 Earth Quintessence; bonus 1 Wind Quintessence. Progress (early evening day 87): Millstone Turn consolidated in meditation, holds at medium speed, still needs work at full speed; Grinding Wheel and Empty Hand not started. Morning day 88: Grinding Wheel full shape learned with the practice hammer (low, high, low circles, rising strike, two-hand catch, back into circles); drilled a few hundred reps, then tracked Rufus as he circled (feet leading) for nearly two hours; after Moonwell and a water break, about an hour and a half with Rufus stepping in and reaching: strikes find him, turns carry Nate around his reach, form held until it slipped at noon. Wheel nearly there. Afternoon session: held aura restraint under Farrah's aura pressure, then learned to save the hammer when Rufus deflects, jams, or shoves it back (turn with it so the circle swallows the mistake). Late afternoon day 88: Empty Hand found unarmed after Gary tripped him mid-run (rolled out of it, then cartwheel, round-off, back flip); repeated slowly from a leg swing into spin and cartwheel, and Rufus named it Empty Hand. First success, not mastered; remaining: show Hollis at her forge, plus the Invictus spar bonus. Night day 88: Grinding Wheel and Empty Hand consolidated in meditation. Dawn to early morning day 89: Grinding Wheel with Invictus at the Society field. Clean solo runs (the heavier head pulls the circle a hand's width wider). Ten runs with Rufus deflecting (palm, forearm, stepping into the line): two self-hits (hip with Invictus's charge, shoulder clip), eight held by going with the late swing. Rufus: keep telling yourself whatever you told yourself. Not yet a spar, so the bonus stays open. Days 89-92: more Invictus Wheel reps alongside mark-chain drills; still no spar, bonus open.

missions.name: The Turning Millstone
missions.detail: Completed noon day 87 at the Society training field. Bought the book from Hollis for 200 iron and absorbed it with Rufus, Gary, Jason and Farrah watching. Bonus met: stayed conscious through the whole absorption. Paid 75 iron and 1 Earth Quintessence, bonus 1 Wind Quintessence, plus 25 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Foundation First
missions.detail: Landed day 80 night at Rufus's suite. Completed day 87 morning on the Society training field. Objective: pass Rufus's test for a skill book 1/1 (staff-pressure body-control test). Bonus: passed on the first attempt 1/1. Paid on completion: 100 iron spirit coins, 1 Earth Quintessence, bonus 1 Wind Quintessence, plus 50 iron unlisted. The skill book still has to be bought.

missions.name: Beyond the Wall
missions.detail: Landed day 80 afternoon during Farrah's Second Wind test run (lap 19). Completed day 80 at dusk when Farrah called it after 21 laps. Objective: finish the test run with no potions or spirit coins 1/1. Bonus: finished on his own legs after a sprint final lap with Gary 1/1. Paid on completion: 75 iron spirit coins, 1 Wind Quintessence, bonus 1 Water Quintessence, plus 25 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Broken Fences
missions.detail: Landed day 78 evening (Jason's contract, eastern farms). Objectives: find whatever is chewing through the fences 1/1 (a mangrove snatcher, iron rank, one-star, six-legged croc, 12 ft plus); deal with it 1/1 (killed day 79 mid-morning in the mangroves past Dorran's farm). Bonus: combined attack with Jason 1/1 (on-three skull slam with his throat strike). Paid on completion: 100 iron spirit coins, 1 Earth Quintessence, bonus 1 Wind Quintessence, plus 25 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Hunter's Road II
missions.detail: Slay one-star monsters 30/30 (completed during days 69-77: hedgehogs, northern-ditch frogs, west barn ratlings). Paid on completion: 300 iron spirit coins, 1 Earth Quintessence, 1 Water Quintessence, 1 Wind Quintessence, 1 Awakening Stone of Persistence, plus 100 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Hunter's Road
missions.detail: Slay one-star monsters 15/15 (3 overflow carried to Hunter's Road II). Paid on completion: 150 iron spirit coins, 1 Lightning Quintessence, 1 Wind Quintessence, 1 Awakening Stone of the Storm, plus 75 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Eyes and Aura
missions.detail: Completed day 79 evening. Main objectives: Awakening Stone of Eyes bought from Seven; Awakening Stone of Omens absorbed day 78. Reward paid: 200 iron plus 100 unlisted iron. Bonus objective complete 2/2 (Harbinger aura; Starward Gaze perception). Bonus reward: 1 common awakening stone, deposited to Pocket Space.

missions.name: Arm's Length
missions.detail: Killed the bark lurker on the south road orchard lane, past the third marker 1/1. Bonus: no limb lost 1/1. Paid: 100 iron spirit coins, 1 earth quintessence, 25 iron (bonus), plus 75 iron unlisted. Society contract turned in (40 iron).

missions.name: Bean Counting
missions.detail: Cleared all 11 ratlings from the Callow farm bean rows. Bonus met: none reached their burrows. Paid on completion: 100 iron spirit coins, bonus 1 water quintessence, plus 50 iron unlisted. (Society contract turned in, 35 iron.)

missions.name: Aether back pay
missions.detail: Claimed: 645 iron spirit coins, Water Quintessence x2, Awakening Stone of the Sky.

missions.name: Thorny-Tongue Frogs
missions.detail: Killed and looted 3 thorny-tongue frogs at the east farmstead ditches. Paid 30 iron.

missions.name: Bog Shambler of Hule
missions.detail: Killed the shambler in Hule's east field. Paid 25 iron.

missions.name: The Final Piece
missions.detail: Clear the Sunken Shrine (tidal caves, two hours south along the coast; Varrow estate contract, taken by Rufus's team). Reward: 1 unidentified essence plus coin.

missions.name: Something in the Pipe
missions.detail: Killed three pipe beasts in the tannery culvert, including the pack leader. One small one escaped into the drains. Paid 50 lesser (40 plus 10 for recovered hides). Looted 14 lesser and 1 iron-rank pipe beast pelt.

missions.name: Beneath the Old City
missions.detail: Found the nest in an old cistern beneath the drains. With Gary, killed three adults, the runt that fled the culvert, and a spined iron-rank beast. Reward 10 lesser.

missions.name: Warehouse Pests
missions.detail: Complete: paid 60 lesser, looted 9 lesser + 1 pelt.

missions.name: Rumour
missions.detail: Rumour: shimmering scaled creature surfacing near the Island reefs at dusk. Hide merchant pays iron. Gary says no.

missions.name: Cellar Dwellers
missions.detail: Wet Barrel tavern, Old City docks. Earlier: one ratling escaped down a burrow, now bricked up; Mags expected Nate back once he was a real adventurer. Updated night day 92: Nate came back at iron rank. The old brickwork held, but for a couple of weeks Mags has heard scratching behind the far cellar wall, likely more than one. Objectives: find what is behind the far wall; clear the cellar. Bonus: find where they are getting in and close it for good. Rewards: 40 iron, 1 iron-rank healing potion; bonus 1 Earth Quintessence. Progress: behind the far wall is a gnawed tunnel hole about 2 feet across, hidden behind crates in the corner; 6 ratlings killed (1 by Invictus, 3 by Thunderhead, 2 finished with Invictus); cellar clear for now. Main objectives COMPLETE night day 92: 40 iron + 8 iron unlisted spirit coins and 1 iron-rank healing potion auto-deposited. Bonus still OPEN: the hole leads into a draughty tunnel; find where they are getting in and close it for good (1 Earth Quintessence). Night day 92: followed the tunnel into an Old City drain; the ratling trail led to a bent grate and a passage beyond; killed a huge ratling there that tore the grate open. Entry still not closed. Source found night day 92: a natural lightning-aligned magic upwelling in a domed chamber below the drains, once sealed with mortar and deliberately chiselled open again (Waterworks crate and circle-and-wave mark nearby). Bonus progress: find where they are getting in 1/1; close it for good 1/1 (the upwelling capped by the Society crew, mid-morning day 94). BONUS COMPLETE: 1 Earth Quintessence + 10 iron unlisted auto-deposited.

missions.name: Floorboard Feeders
missions.detail: Warehouse 9, Verdant Fields. Three mist eels cleared.

missions.name: Shell Shock
missions.detail: Channel fight. Reward: 1 Water Quintessence.

missions.name: Plumbing Problem
missions.detail: Waterfall shab. Reward: 5 iron spirit coins.

missions.name: The Evil Pit of Evil
missions.detail: Survive the ritual. Reward: Lightning Essence.

missions.name: Stranger in a Strange Land
missions.detail: Explore the estate grounds. Reward: Simple Pants.

missions.name: The Drowned Map
missions.detail: Reached the Vault beyond Cistern No. 3 with Rufus, Farrah, and Gary. Killed the stone centipede. Reward: Star Essence (claimed).

missions.name: Field Assessment
missions.detail: A week of delta postings by wagon with Vincent Trenslow's group of 8. Day 1: rune tortoise in the paddies, PASSED. Day 2: watched Jason's bark lurker; declined the trap weaver notice (correct call: no one). Day 3: thorny-tongue frog (extra, not pass/fail). Day 5: marsh wyrm, graded, complete. Day 7: back in Greenstone; PASSED, badge to be issued at the Society tomorrow.

missions.name: Magic Society: Wetland Cores
missions.detail: Delivered 8 cores to Aldous Fenwick (Archivist Wing). Paid 36 iron. He'll vouch for Nate with the stone brokers if Nate keeps bringing good or odd cores.

missions.name: North road hedgehogs
missions.detail: Society one-star open contract. 2 iron per kill (spine bundle as proof). Paid so far: 20 iron (10), 10 iron (5 bundles, day 62), 12 iron (6 bundles, days 69-77). Contract stays open.

missions.name: Northern frogs
missions.detail: Society one-star open contract (northern farmstead ditches), 4 iron per kill. Paid: 28 iron (7), 12 iron (3, day 62), 16 iron (4, days 69-77). CLOSED.

missions.name: West barn nest
missions.detail: Society one-star contract. Nest was ratlings; 9 killed during days 69-77. Paid 30 iron. CLOSED.

missions.name: Nest Egg
missions.detail: Clear the west barn ratling nest 9/9. Paid on completion: 100 iron spirit coins, 1 Earth Quintessence, plus 50 iron unlisted.

missions.name: Crooked notice
missions.detail: Private job: 5 ratlings killed in an old woman's Old City yard. Nate declined her coins; had stew.

missions.name: Dennick's coop digger
missions.detail: Bram (Mae's neighbour) asked. Something is digging under Dennick Hale's chicken coop at night. Red barn, crooked weathervane, past the 2nd milestone on Hunter's Road, west gate. Pay: a few iron. Not Society-backed. DONE: sand shab killed. Nate declined the 8 iron payment; told Dennick to use it to repair the coop.

missions.name: Scratching in the Dark
missions.detail: Clear the ratling nest under Mae Corran's cottage (Old City). Paid: 100 iron spirit coins.

missions.name: Something Under the Coop
missions.detail: Stop whatever is digging under Dennick Hale's coop (sand shab). Paid: 100 iron spirit coins, 1 earth quintessence.

missions.name: Bark lurker, south road
missions.detail: Society one-star closed contract. Turned in day 62 (hide checked, kept). Paid 40 iron.

missions.name: Ratlings, south fields
missions.detail: Society one-star closed contract, Callow farm bean rows. Turned in day 62 (cores checked, kept). Paid 35 iron.

missions.name: Something in the Reeds
missions.detail: Landed morning day 109 at Corve's Materials when Nate agreed to look into reed-cutter Osric Fenn's report (private favour; Marit pointed him at Nate). Site: east gate, levee road, past the second culvert; Osric's stilt hut at the far end by the cut. Track nearly 4 ft wide, two nights running, closer to the levee each time; dog won't go near; extra mud-snail shells cracked from outside. Osric offers 11 iron (his savings) plus a dry place to wait for dark (paid by Osric, separate from Aether rewards). Objectives: inspect the flattened reed tracks along the drainage cuts past Holloway's field 0/1; find out what is making them 0/1. Bonus: deal with it before it reaches the levee 0/1. Rewards: 80 iron spirit coins, 1 Water Quintessence. Bonus: 1 Earth Quintessence.

abilities.name: Arc Step

ranks.Bronze: Can carry one willing ally in physical contact. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Dissolve into a streak of lightning and reappear at a point along a line of sight, up to about 60 feet away. Anything in the path takes lightning damage and an instance of [Static Charge]. Each Arc Step grants an instance of [Momentum]. You can arrive in contact with your [Starlit] target or with Invictus (in flight or where it landed) if it is in line of sight, ready to strike or catch it. While you hold 3 or more instances of [Momentum], Invictus's charged hits also inflict [Static Charge]. Cannot carry passengers. Cost: Low mana [4%]. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Star Mark

ranks.Bronze: Two marks at once. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Mark a creature or object you can see with [Starlit]. You always feel its direction and distance, through walls and floors, out to about 3,300 feet at iron rank, fading near the edge. One mark at a time; no upkeep. You see your afflictions on the target as faint stars. Weapons you throw at the marked target curve toward it, enough to bend around minor cover or correct a near miss, and strike with added weight: each thrown hit on it inflicts an instance of [Starweight]. Cost: Very low mana [2%]. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Stormveil

ranks.Bronze: Deflected projectiles can be turned back along their path, weakened. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)
ranks.Silver: The scarf's lightening grows from gliding into true flight (Nate's only flight path). (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Conjures a long scarf of storm cloud, soft as harbour fog, with threads of blue lightning running through it. Its loose end trails behind you, growing longer the faster you move. Worn: it deflects projectiles and blunts blows, more so for each instance of [Momentum] you hold, and enemies who strike you in melee gain [Static Charge]. Your [Momentum] fades half as fast. It makes you lighter, so you fall slowly, can glide down from heights and land safely. You can't stand on water, but you can run across it while you keep up your speed. Shed: the scarf unravels into lightning that crawls over your body, sharply raising your movement speed. You lose its defence until it reweaves. Cost: Low mana [5%] to raise, then very low mana [1%] per minute; shedding costs low mana per second. Cooldown: None; after a Shed ends, the scarf takes 10 seconds to reweave before you can shed again.

abilities.tag: Comet · Special attack (melee, thrown, fire, light)
abilities.name: Comet Strike

ranks.Bronze: The movement before your strike leaves a burning comet trail on the ground for a few seconds; enemies who cross it catch the burn. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Your weapon, fist, or a thrown weapon ignites with a white-gold comet trail. The strike consumes all your instances of [Momentum], dealing additional damage for each, and inflicts an instance of [Comet Burn], plus one more for every 2 instances of [Momentum] consumed. If the target carries 3 or more instances of [Static Charge], the strike grounds them: all instances are consumed, the target takes lightning damage for each, and it is stunned for a moment. Cost: Low mana [6%] and low stamina [5%]. Cooldown: 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Constellation

ranks.Bronze: The pool can be conjured anywhere in line of sight, not just at your feet. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Conjures three motes of starlight that orbit you until dismissed or until you sleep. The motes give off light that you can brighten or dim. You can fling a mote at a target within about 60 feet; it deals star damage, inflicts [Starweight], and curves onto your [Starlit] target. You can set a mote into a weapon as you throw or swing it, adding star damage and an instance of [Starweight] to its next hit. You can ground all three motes to form a well of starlit water about 10 feet across at your feet for 1 minute: allies in it regain 2% health, 2% stamina and 1% mana every few seconds and minor afflictions are washed away. The well can be formed once every 3 minutes, and the motes do not re-form while it lasts. Cost: Moderate mana [10%] to conjure. Each spent mote re-forms after 20 seconds at very low mana [1%]. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Storm Front

ranks.Bronze: Allies beneath the storm also gain the wind's favour (faster Momentum-style speed while moving). (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)
ranks.Silver: The storm can cover a much larger area and follow you. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Calls down a low ceiling of storm sky over an area about 30 feet across, centred on a point you can see within about 60 feet; it can be moved at walking pace with focus. Beneath it the wind favours you: you gain [Momentum] from movement twice as fast and it does not fade while you are moving, and your Squall reaches farther and hits harder. Enemies beneath it fight gusts and driving rain: their footing and ranged attacks suffer and their senses are dulled. Your Thunderhead can be called down out of the cloud onto any point beneath it instead of erupting from you. You can launch upward into the cloud ceiling on the wind (up to about 20 feet) and begin a dive from it, which counts as a charge for Comet Strike and as an attack from above for Starward Gaze. Enemies carrying [Static Charge] beneath the storm gain another instance every few seconds. Cost: Moderate mana [10%] to conjure, then very low mana [1%] every 10 seconds to sustain. Cooldown: 30 seconds after it ends.

abilities.name: Squall

ranks.Bronze: Anything shoved into a wall, tree or other solid object takes impact damage and is briefly dazed. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Releases a sudden blast of storm wind in a cone out to about 15 feet, shoving everything caught in it back and off balance; lighter targets are knocked down, and projectiles are knocked off course. Each enemy already carrying [Comet Burn] gains another instance. Enemies shoved into your Abyssal Star's pull gain an instance of [Starweight]. You can instead fire Squall behind you to launch yourself up or forward, gaining an instance of [Momentum]. Cost: Low mana [5%]. Cooldown: 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Harbinger

ranks.Bronze: Allies in your aura recover stamina faster while they're moving. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Allies within the aura (about 30 feet) have increased movement speed. Enemies within it feel the comet coming: their defences are weakened against attacks from anyone who is moving, more so for each instance of [Momentum] you hold. Your afflictions on them fade more slowly. Cost: None. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Starward Gaze

ranks.Bronze: Sense magic: enchantments and active magic show in whatever you magnify. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: See fine detail at great distances as clearly as if it were close; line of sight only. Focusing on a creature for a moment reveals a weak point and inflicts [Exposed]: your next hit on it partially ignores armour or natural plating and deals increased damage, consuming the affliction. One target at a time. Attacks you make from above, whether falling, diving from Storm Front's ceiling or a Veil glide, or throws arcing down, deal increased damage, more with each instance of [Starweight] on the target. [Exposed] (affliction, star): see above. Not stacking. Cost: None. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Thunderhead

ranks.Bronze: Lightning arcs between enemies caught in the burst and jumps a short way to nearby enemies outside it. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: A burst of storm-lightning rips out about 10 feet, shocking every enemy caught in it, staggering them briefly and inflicting 2 instances of [Static Charge]. The burst can erupt from you, from Invictus wherever it is within 60 feet (it is lightning-attuned), or from your active Abyssal Star, catching everything in its pull. Enemies that already carry [Static Charge] are stunned for a moment instead of staggered. Cost: Moderate mana [12%]. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Second Wind

ranks.Bronze: Also restores 10% mana when it triggers. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Whenever you consume instances of [Momentum], recover 2% mana and 2% stamina for each instance consumed. While you are moving, your natural mana and stamina recovery is as fast as it is at rest. When your stamina falls below 25%, the wind fills you and you recover 25% stamina; this can happen once every 10 minutes, and it triggers as soon as that time is up if you are still below 25%. Cost: None. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Quarry's Wake

ranks.Bronze: Allies moving toward your Star Mark target get the speed boost too. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Your movement speed increases while you move toward your [Starlit] target, and your [Momentum] does not fade while you do. Moving toward it grants an instance of [Momentum] every 2 seconds. Each time a weapon you throw hits your [Starlit] target, gain an instance of [Momentum], and the weapon returns to you faster. Cost: None. Cooldown: None.

abilities.name: Starfall Feast

ranks.Gold: Sealed (no Magic Society record; revealed at rank-up).
ranks.Bronze: Sealed (no Magic Society record; revealed at rank-up).
ranks.Silver: Sealed (no Magic Society record; revealed at rank-up).
ranks.Diamond: Sealed (no Magic Society record; revealed at rank-up).

abilities.detail: Speak the incantation to ignite every instance of [Comet Burn] on a target within about 30 feet (your [Starlit] target within about 60 feet) in a single white-gold flare, consuming them all at once. Deals immediate radiant fire damage that scales sharply with the number of [Comet Burn] instances consumed, restoring a burst of health, stamina, and mana for each instance burned and granting 1 instance of [Momentum] for every 2 instances consumed. If the flare kills the target, the restorative surge doubles and a wave of starfire splashes outward to inflict [Comet Burn] on nearby enemies. Cost: Low mana [5%]. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Abyssal Star

ranks.Bronze: Sealed (no Magic Society record; revealed at rank-up).

abilities.detail: Conjures a tiny, dense, dark star at a point you can see within about 60 feet, or binds it to your [Starlit] target so it follows. Enemies within about 15 feet are dragged toward its centre, slowed, take ongoing crushing damage, and gain an instance of [Starweight] every 2 seconds they stay in the pull. Your thrown weapons and your own charges that pass into the pull are accelerated, dealing increased damage; you ignore the drag of your own star. It lasts as long as you sustain it. You can move it up to 15 feet per second, drop it, or collapse it: a burst that strikes everything in the pull, dealing additional damage for each instance of [Starweight] on each target and consuming them. Cost: Moderate mana [10%] to conjure, then low mana per second [about 1% every 2 seconds] to sustain. Cooldown: 20 seconds (starting when the star ends).

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.detail: Call down a brisk, crackling rain of charged droplets over a 20-foot radius (centred on you, on your [Starlit] target within 60 feet, or directly beneath an active Storm Front) for 10 seconds. Enemies in the rain take minor lightning damage and gain an instance of [Static Charge] every 3 seconds. Lightning damage dealt to an enemy inside the rain arcs lightly to one nearby enemy in the rain. While you are inside the rain, your movement and attack speed are slightly increased, and Arc Step can jump to any point within the rain even without clear line of sight. Cost: Low mana [6%]. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Overcharge

ranks.Bronze: Lightning arcs from your strikes to a second nearby enemy carrying [Static Charge]. (Magic Society record, nearest match; not guaranteed, revealed at rank-up.)

abilities.detail: Channel live lightning through your nerves and muscles, surrounding yourself in a crackling blue-white nimbus for as long as you sustain it. Sharply increases your movement speed, reflexes, and attack speed, and adds extra lightning damage to your weapon and unarmed strikes. While active, you build [Momentum] faster (every third strike or dodge also grants a stack) and your [Momentum] cap rises by 1. Enemies who strike you in melee take minor shock damage, and ending Overcharge early discharges built-up current in a quick 5-foot shockwave that shoves nearby foes back. Cost: Low mana [5%] to activate, then low mana [3%] and very low stamina [2%] every 10 seconds to sustain. Cooldown: 30 seconds after it ends.
